field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Declares Qwen as the frozen headline GGUF and Gemma models as optional replication paths.
field_principles.adaptation_slope: Shows whether accuracy improves across the ordered family stream.
field_principles.arms: Lists reset-free, reset-each, shuffled-feedback, and no-adaptation controls.
field_principles.backward_retention_by_session: Measures earlier-family retention after every session boundary.
field_principles.confidence_intervals: Uses paired bootstrap intervals over independent instance IDs.
field_principles.continual_harness_candidate: only reset-free improvement with bounded retention loss, safe false accepts, and rollback may enter delayed stress.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_target: Bare boolean marking this as the reset-free continuous self-learning slot.
field_principles.cost_receipt: Accounts for latency, tokens, memory bytes, and energy-update cost.
field_principles.device_receipt: Preserves CUDA device identity and llama.cpp offload support evidence.
field_principles.energy_weights_mutated: Discloses that the external energy calibrator updates while GGUF weights do not.
field_principles.exact_feedback_only: Guards against external teacher labels or heuristic labels entering adaptation.
field_principles.false_accept_delta: Prevents reset-free from increasing unsafe invalid-row accepts.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why every headline and gate field exists.
field_principles.gate_receipt: Records upstream, cache, CUDA/offload, corpus, and live-invocation gates before interpreting quality.
field_principles.gpu_offload_authenticated: Prevents CPU-only llama.cpp execution from entering the headline arm.
field_principles.harness_state_persisted: Shows only the Exp5569 memory policy and Exp5570 energy calibrator persist.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal complete or blocked status for the conductor.
field_principles.inference_duration_s: Records live Qwen invocation plus harness evaluation duration.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares live local SOTA reset-free exact-feedback harness execution.
field_principles.live_model_invoked: Separates an authenticated local SOTA run from blocked precondition receipts.
field_principles.model_weights_mutated: Confirms frozen GGUF weights; adaptation is external harness state only.
field_principles.n_independent_instances_per_session: Defines the paired statistical denominator per family session.
field_principles.new_family_accuracy_by_arm: Measures solve/verify exact success on each newly encountered family.
field_principles.prior_family_regression: Exposes the retention-loss gate used by continual_harness_candidate.
field_principles.rollback_count: Counts rollback events rather than assuming recovery is free.
field_principles.rollback_success: Requires poisoned or stale harness state to restore to a clean checkpoint.
field_principles.sessions: Shows ordered exact ASP/FSM family sessions and their paired instance IDs.
